source.text: Τότε ἔρχεται μετ’ αὐτῶν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς χωρίον λεγόμενον Γεθσημανὶ, καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς· Καθίσατε αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀπελθὼν ἐκεῖ προσεύξωμαι.

records.literal_gloss: Then comes with them the Jesus to a place called Gethsemane, and he says to the disciples, Sit here until having gone away there I pray.

en.L: Then Jesus comes with them to a place called Gethsemane, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to the disciples, "Sit here while I go over there and pray."
en.B: Jesus then came with them to a place named Gethsemane. He told the disciples, "Stay seated here while I go on over there and pray."
en.R: Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers came to a place called Gethsemane. Jesus said to them, "Stay here. I am going over there to pray."

es.L: Entonces viene Jesús con ellos a un lugar llamado Getsemaní, y dice a los discípulos: «{{plural_you:Siéntense|Sentaos}} aquí mientras me voy allá y oro».
es.B: Entonces Jesús llegó con ellos a un lugar llamado Getsemaní, y dijo a los discípulos: «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} sentados aquí mientras yo voy más allá a orar».
es.R: Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} seguidores llegaron a un lugar llamado Getsemaní. Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} aquí. Yo voy allá a orar».

fr.L: Alors Jésus vient avec eux en un lieu appelé Gethsémani, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit aux disciples : « Asseyez-vous ici, pendant que je m’en vais là-bas pour prier. »
fr.B: Jésus arriva alors avec eux dans un domaine nommé Gethsémani. Il dit aux disciples : « Restez assis ici pendant que je vais là-bas pour prier. »
fr.R: Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples sont arrivés dans un endroit appelé Gethsémani. Jésus leur a dit : « Restez ici. Je vais là-bas pour prier. »

sw.L: Kisha Yesu anakuja pamoja nao mahali paitwapo Gethsemane, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anawaambia wanafunzi, "Kaeni hapa mpaka nitakapokwenda kule nikaomba."
sw.B: Kisha Yesu alifika pamoja nao mahali panapoitwa Gethsemane, akawaambia wanafunzi, "Kaeni hapa wakati ninakwenda pale kuomba."
sw.R: Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walifika mahali panapoitwa Gethsemane. Yesu akawaambia, "Kaeni hapa. Mimi ninakwenda kule kuomba."

vi.L: Bấy giờ Đức Giê-xu đến cùng với họ tại một nơi gọi là Ghết-sê-ma-nê, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với các môn đồ: "Hãy ngồi đây cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đi qua đằng kia cầu nguyện."
vi.B: Rồi Đức Giê-xu cùng các môn đồ đến một nơi gọi là Ghết-sê-ma-nê. Ngài bảo họ: "Hãy ngồi lại đây trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đi qua đằng kia cầu nguyện."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ đến một nơi gọi là Ghết-sê-ma-nê. Ngài nói với họ: "Hãy ở lại đây. Ta đi qua đằng kia để cầu nguyện."

ko.L: 그때 예수께서 그들과 함께 겟세마네라고 하는 곳으로 가신다. 그리고 제자들에게 말씀하신다. "내가 저기 가서 기도하는 동안 여기 앉아 있어라."
ko.B: 그 뒤에 예수께서 제자들과 함께 겟세마네라는 곳에 가셨다. 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 저쪽에 가서 기도하는 동안 너희는 여기 앉아 있어라."
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들과 함께 겟세마네라는 곳에 가셨다. 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "여기 앉아 있어라. 나는 저기 가서 기도하겠다."

pt.L: Então Jesus vem com eles a um lugar chamado Getsêmani, e diz aos discípulos: "Sentem-se aqui enquanto eu vou ali orar."
pt.B: Então Jesus chegou com eles a um lugar chamado Getsêmani. Ele disse aos discípulos: "Fiquem sentados aqui enquanto eu vou até ali orar."
pt.R: Jesus e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores chegaram a um lugar chamado Getsêmani. Jesus disse a eles: "Fiquem aqui. Eu vou até ali para orar."

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ከእነርሱ ጋር ጌቴሴማኒ ወደምትባል ስፍራ ይመጣል፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም፦ «ወደዚያ ሄጄ እስክጸልይ ድረስ እዚህ ተቀመጡ።» ይላቸዋል።
am.B: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ከእነርሱ ጋር ጌቴሴማኒ ወደሚባል ቦታ መጣ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም፦ «እኔ ወደዚያ ሄጄ እስክጸልይ ድረስ እዚህ ተቀመጡ።» አላቸው።
am.R: ኢየሱስና ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጌቴሴማኒ ወደሚባል ቦታ መጡ። ኢየሱስም፦ «እዚህ ቆዩ። እኔ ወደዚያ ሄጄ ልጸልይ ነው።» አላቸው።

decisions.choice: Gethsemane: a plot of land on the Mount of Olives
decisions.reason: The name means "oil press". John 18:1 calls it a garden; it was likely an olive grove.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on separate pronouns and possessives (sus, lo, le, me, mí, mi, tú, tu); plural_you on every plural "you"
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject pronoun out ("dice", "dijo"), and a pronoun joined to the end of a verb ("apresarme") takes no span, so the deity_pronoun setting covers fewer words than in English. Jesus speaks to the disciples and to the crowd, so every plural "you" is the ustedes / vosotros setting. The same through the passage.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Matthew's historic presents kept as presents at Literal ("vient", "dit", "trouve")
decisions.reason: As set for Matthew and in Mark 14: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and as young readers meet stories. Literal keeps the present where Matthew tells a past event in the present (26:36, 26:38, 26:40, 26:45, 26:52), as English Literal does. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on free pronouns and possessives only (naye, wake, yangu, nami); none on verbs such as anawaambia
decisions.reason: Swahili carries "he" and "him" in the verb, where a prefix cannot take a capital, so the setting covers only free pronouns and possessives, as in John. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English through the passage.

decisions.choice: "Ghết-sê-ma-nê"; Literal keeps the historic present ("đến", "nói") without "đã", here and through the passage
decisions.reason: The Protestant spelling, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:32. Vietnamese verbs do not change for tense, so Literal shows Matthew's present-tense storytelling by leaving out the past marker.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 26:36-56; "그분" (L), "예수" (B, R) in the narrative, with "께서" and -시-; Jesus speaks in the plain style (해라체); Matthew's historic presents stay present only at Literal ("가신다", "말씀하신다")
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect for Jesus is carried by the honorific (style guide, sections 4 and 7), as in the Korean Mark 14:32-52 and Matthew 24.

decisions.choice: orar
decisions.reason: "Orar" is the word for speaking to God in one's own words; "rezar" suggests reciting set prayers to many Brazilian readers.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The English lets the reader capitalise pronouns for God and Christ. The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic, and the Amharic text of this passage carries no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "ደቀ መዛሙርት" (disciples) at Readable too
decisions.reason: "ደቀ መዛሙርት" is the everyday Amharic word for a teacher's disciples, so it stays at every level, the book-wide term.

source.text: καὶ παραλαβὼν τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Ζεβεδαίου ἤρξατο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken along the Peter and the two sons of Zebedee he began to be sorrowful and to be distressed.

en.L: And taking along Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
en.B: He took Peter and Zebedee's two sons with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to be filled with grief and anguish.
en.R: He took Peter, James, and John with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Jesus began to feel very sad and troubled.

es.L: Y llevando consigo a Pedro y a los dos hijos de Zebedeo, comenzó a estar triste y profundamente afligido.
es.B: Llevó consigo a Pedro y a los dos hijos de Zebedeo, y comenzó a llenarse de tristeza y de angustia.
es.R: Se llevó a Pedro, a Santiago y a Juan. Jesús empezó a sentirse muy triste y angustiado.

fr.L: Et ayant pris avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} Pierre et les deux fils de Zébédée, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commença à être triste et profondément angoissé.
fr.B: Il prit avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} Pierre et les deux fils de Zébédée, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commença à être envahi par la tristesse et l’angoisse.
fr.R: Il a pris avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} Pierre, Jacques et Jean. Jésus a commencé à se sentir très triste et bouleversé.

sw.L: Na akiwachukua Petro na wale wana wawili wa Zebedayo, alianza kujawa na huzuni na dhiki nzito.
sw.B: Aliwachukua Petro na wana wawili wa Zebedayo pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, akaanza kujawa na huzuni na dhiki kuu.
sw.R: Aliwachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana. Yesu akaanza kuhisi huzuni nyingi na kufadhaika.

vi.L: Và đem Phi-e-rơ cùng hai con trai của Xê-bê-đê theo, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu buồn rầu và sầu não.
vi.B: Ngài đem Phi-e-rơ và hai con trai của Xê-bê-đê theo, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu buồn rầu, lòng đầy đau khổ.
vi.R: Ngài đem Phi-e-rơ, Gia-cơ và Giăng đi cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đức Giê-xu bắt đầu thấy rất buồn và lo âu.

ko.L: 그리고 베드로와 세베대의 두 아들을 데리고 가셔서, 슬퍼하며 몹시 괴로워하기 시작하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 베드로와 세베대의 두 아들을 데리고 가셨는데, 슬픔과 괴로움에 잠기기 시작하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 베드로와 야고보와 요한을 데리고 가셨다. 예수께서는 몹시 슬프고 괴로워지기 시작하셨다.

pt.L: E, levando consigo Pedro e os dois filhos de Zebedeu, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} começou a se entristecer e a se angustiar profundamente.
pt.B: Ele levou consigo Pedro e os dois filhos de Zebedeu, e começou a se encher de tristeza e de angústia.
pt.R: Ele levou Pedro, Tiago e João junto com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Jesus começou a sentir muita tristeza e angústia.

am.L: ጴጥሮስንና ሁለቱን የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ከእርሱ ጋር ወስዶ ሊያዝንና ሊጨነቅ ጀመረ።
am.B: ጴጥሮስንና ሁለቱን የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ይዞ ሄደ፤ ሐዘንና ጭንቀትም ይሰማው ጀመር።
am.R: ጴጥሮስን፣ ያዕቆብንና ዮሐንስን ይዞ ሄደ። ኢየሱስ በጣም ማዘንና መጨነቅ ጀመረ።

decisions.choice: Peter and the two sons of Zebedee: Peter, James and John
decisions.reason: The same three were with Jesus on the mountain where he was transfigured (17:1). The sons of Zebedee are James and John (4:21).

decisions.choice: deeply distressed: in anguish, overwhelmed
decisions.reason: The word describes deep inner turmoil.

decisions.choice: James, and John
decisions.reason: Readable names the two brothers.

decisions.choice: "Gia-cơ và Giăng" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names Zebedee's sons, as the English Readable does (Matthew 4:21; 10:2).

source.text: τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς· Περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου· μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε μετ’ ἐμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Then he says to them, Very sorrowful is the soul of me unto death; remain here and watch with me.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to them, "My soul is very sorrowful, even to death; stay here and keep watch with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "My soul is weighed down with grief, even to death. Stay here and keep awake with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: He said to them, "My heart is so full of sadness that I feel I could die. Stay here and keep watch with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Entonces les dice: «Llena de tristeza está {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma, hasta la muerte; {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} aquí y {{plural_you:vigilen|vigilad}} conmigo».
es.B: Entonces les dijo: «Mi alma está abrumada de tristeza, hasta la muerte. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} aquí y {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} despiertos conmigo».
es.R: Les dijo: «Tengo el corazón tan lleno de tristeza que siento que me voy a morir. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} aquí y {{plural_you:vigilen|vigilad}} conmigo».

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme est accablée de tristesse jusqu’à la mort ; demeurez ici et veillez avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme est accablée de tristesse, d’une tristesse à en mourir. Restez ici et veillez avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: Il leur a dit : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur est si plein de tristesse que j’ai l’impression que je vais mourir. Restez ici et restez éveillés avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »

sw.L: Kisha anawaambia, "Nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ina huzuni nyingi mno, hata kufikia kifo; bakini hapa, mkae macho pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}."
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} imelemewa na huzuni, hata kufikia kifo. Bakini hapa, mkae macho pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}."
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Moyo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} umejaa huzuni kiasi kwamba nahisi naweza kufa. Bakini hapa, mkae macho pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}."

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} buồn rầu lắm, cho đến chết; hãy ở lại đây và thức canh với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} buồn rầu đến chết được. Hãy ở lại đây và thức canh với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Ngài nói với họ: "Lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} buồn rầu đến nỗi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cảm thấy như sắp chết. Hãy ở lại đây và thức canh với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 그때 그들에게 말씀하신다. "내 영혼이 죽을 지경으로 몹시 슬프다. 여기 머물러 나와 함께 깨어 있어라."
ko.B: 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내 마음이 너무 슬퍼서 죽을 것만 같다. 너희는 여기 머물면서 나와 함께 깨어 있어라."
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내 마음이 슬픔으로 가득해서 죽을 것만 같다. 여기 머물러 있으면서 나와 함께 깨어 있어라."

pt.L: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes diz: "Muito triste está a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} alma, até a morte; fiquem aqui e vigiem {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}."
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "A {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} alma está carregada de tristeza, a ponto de morrer. Fiquem aqui e permaneçam acordados {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}."
pt.R: Ele disse a eles: "O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} coração está tão cheio de tristeza que sinto que vou morrer. Fiquem aqui e vigiem {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}."

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ፦ «ነፍሴ እስከ ሞት ድረስ እጅግ አዝናለች፤ እዚህ ቆዩ፤ ከእኔም ጋር ንቁ።» ይላቸዋል።
am.B: ከዚያም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ነፍሴ እስከ ሞት ድረስ በሐዘን ተውጣለች። እዚህ ቆዩ፤ ከእኔም ጋር ንቁ።»
am.R: እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ልቤ በሐዘን ስለ ተሞላ የምሞት ይመስለኛል። እዚህ ቆዩ፤ ከእኔም ጋር ንቁ።»

decisions.choice: my soul is very sorrowful: Psalms 42-43
decisions.reason: The psalmist asks, "Why are you cast down, my soul?" (Psalm 42:5, 11; 43:5). Jesus uses the psalm's language for his grief.

decisions.choice: even to death: grief so heavy it could kill
alternatives: sorrow because death is near only
decisions.reason: The phrase measures the depth of the grief. Compare Jonah 4:9.

decisions.choice: keep watch: stay awake and alert
decisions.reason: The same verb is used in 24:42 and 25:13 for being ready.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: My heart is so full of sadness that I feel I could die
alternatives: My soul is very sorrowful, even to death
decisions.reason: Readable explains the saying.

decisions.choice: veillez (L, B); restez éveillés (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 14:34: "veiller" is the French word for staying awake on watch and carries the call to be alert (m3), so Literal and Balanced keep it here and in 26:40-41; Readable says plainly "stay awake", which is what the English "keep watch" asks.

decisions.choice: nafsi
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the soul as the seat of feeling, the self (meaning decision m1). "Nafsi" says that; "roho" is kept for "spirit" in verse 41, where the Greek uses a different word. Readable says "moyo" (heart), as the English does.

decisions.choice: mkae macho
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is to stay awake and alert (meaning decision m3). "Kukaa macho" says both plainly and is used at every level here and in verses 40-41; "kukesha" is mostly to stay up through the night.

decisions.choice: "linh hồn" (L, B); "lòng" (R); "thức canh"
decisions.reason: The wording of the Vietnamese Mark 14:34, the parallel: "linh hồn" for the troubled soul, the everyday "lòng" at Readable; "thức canh" is staying awake on watch.

decisions.choice: "내 영혼" (L); "내 마음" (B, R) for psyche; "머무르다" for meno; "깨어 있다" for gregoreo (26:38-41)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:34: psyche is the seat of feeling, in the words of Psalms 42-43 (meaning decision), not the life that can be lost; "깨어 있어라" keeps the call to stay awake and alert.

decisions.choice: "ንቁ" (keep awake, be alert)
decisions.reason: "ንቁ" says both staying awake and being alert, as the Greek verb does, in an everyday word; the same in 26:40-41 and in 25:13.

source.text: καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ προσευχόμενος καὶ λέγων· Πάτερ μου, εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν, παρελθάτω ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο· πλὴν οὐχ ὡς ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλ’ ὡς σύ.

records.literal_gloss: And having gone forward a little he fell on face of him praying and saying, Father of me, if possible it is, let pass from me the cup this; yet not as I will but as you.

en.L: And going a little farther, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fell on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face, praying and saying, "My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; yet not as I will, but as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [will]."
en.B: He went a little farther, threw {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} face down on the ground, and prayed, "My Father, if there is any way, let this cup pass by {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. But not what I want; what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want."
en.R: He went a little farther and lay down with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face on the ground. He prayed, "My Father, if it is possible, do not make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} drink this cup of suffering. But do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want, not what I want."

es.L: Y avanzando un poco más, cayó sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro, orando y diciendo: «Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, si es posible, que se aleje de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} esta copa; sin embargo, no como yo quiero, sino como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [quieres]».
es.B: Avanzó un poco más, se postró con el rostro en tierra y oró: «Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, si hay alguna manera, que esta copa pase lejos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Pero no lo que yo quiero, sino lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres».
es.R: Se adelantó un poco y se echó con la cara en el suelo. Oró así: «Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, si es posible, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hagas beber esta copa de sufrimiento. Pero haz lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, no lo que quiero yo».

fr.L: Et s’étant avancé un peu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tomba sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face, priant et disant : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, si c’est possible, que cette coupe passe loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; pourtant, non pas comme je veux, mais comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux]. »
fr.B: Il alla un peu plus loin, se jeta face contre terre et pria : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, s’il y a un moyen, que cette coupe s’éloigne de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ! Pourtant, non pas ce que je veux, mais ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux. »
fr.R: Il est allé un peu plus loin et s’est couché, le visage contre le sol. Il a prié : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, si c’est possible, ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fais pas boire cette coupe de souffrance. Mais fais ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux, et non ce que je veux. »

sw.L: Kisha akasogea mbele kidogo, akaanguka juu ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akiomba na kusema, "Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ikiwa inawezekana, kikombe hiki na kiondoke {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}; hata hivyo, si jinsi ninavyotaka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, ila jinsi unavyotaka {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}."
sw.B: Alienda mbele kidogo, akajitupa chini kifudifudi, akaomba, "Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ikiwa kuna njia yoyote, kikombe hiki kinipite mbali. Lakini isiwe ninavyotaka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, bali unavyotaka {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}."
sw.R: Alisogea mbele kidogo, akalala chini, uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ukigusa ardhi. Akaomba, "Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ikiwezekana, usinifanye ninywe kikombe hiki cha mateso. Lakini fanya unavyotaka {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, si ninavyotaka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."

vi.L: Và đi tới trước một chút, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sấp mặt xuống đất, cầu nguyện và nói: "Cha của Con ơi, nếu có thể được, xin cho chén này qua khỏi Con; nhưng không phải như Con muốn, mà như Cha [muốn]."
vi.B: Ngài đi xa hơn một chút, sấp mặt xuống đất và cầu nguyện: "Cha ơi, nếu có thể được, xin cho chén này lìa khỏi Con. Nhưng xin đừng theo ý Con, mà theo ý Cha."
vi.R: Ngài đi thêm một quãng ngắn rồi nằm sấp mặt xuống đất. Ngài cầu nguyện: "Cha ơi, nếu có thể được, xin đừng bắt Con uống chén đau khổ này. Nhưng xin Cha làm theo ý Cha, chứ không theo ý Con."

ko.L: 그리고 조금 앞으로 나아가셔서 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 기도하며 말씀하셨다. "나의 아버지, 할 수 있다면 이 잔이 제게서 지나가게 해 주십시오. 그러나 제가 원하는 대로가 아니라, 아버지께서 [원하시는] 대로 [하십시오]."
ko.B: 예수께서는 조금 더 나아가 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 기도하셨다. "나의 아버지, 할 수만 있으면 이 잔이 저를 비켜 가게 해 주십시오. 그러나 제가 원하는 대로 하지 마시고, 아버지께서 원하시는 대로 하십시오."
ko.R: 예수께서는 조금 더 가셔서 땅에 얼굴을 대고 엎드리셨다. 그리고 기도하셨다. "나의 아버지, 할 수만 있다면 이 고난의 잔을 제가 마시지 않게 해 주십시오. 그러나 제가 원하는 대로 하지 마시고, 아버지께서 원하시는 대로 해 주십시오."

pt.L: E, indo um pouco adiante, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} caiu com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rosto em terra, orando e dizendo: "Meu Pai, se for possível, que este cálice passe longe de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; porém não como eu quero, mas como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [queres]."
pt.B: Indo um pouco mais adiante, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lançou com o rosto no chão e orou: "Meu Pai, se houver algum jeito, afasta de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} este cálice. Mas não seja o que eu quero, e sim o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres."
pt.R: Ele foi um pouco mais adiante e se deitou com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rosto no chão. Ele orou: "Meu Pai, se for possível, não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} faças beber este cálice de sofrimento. Mas que seja feito o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres, e não o que eu quero."

am.L: ጥቂትም ወደ ፊት ሄዶ በግንባሩ ተደፍቶ እንዲህ እያለ ጸለየ፦ «አባቴ ሆይ፣ ቢቻልስ ይህ ጽዋ ከእኔ ይለፍ፤ ነገር ግን እኔ እንደምወድ ሳይሆን አንተ እንደምትወድ [ይሁን]።»
am.B: ጥቂት ወደ ፊት ሄዶ በግንባሩ መሬት ላይ ተደፋ፤ እንዲህም ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «አባቴ ሆይ፣ የሚቻል ከሆነ ይህ ጽዋ ከእኔ ይለፍ። ነገር ግን የአንተ ፈቃድ እንጂ የእኔ ፈቃድ አይሁን።»
am.R: ጥቂት ወደ ፊት ሄዶ በግንባሩ መሬት ላይ ተደፋ። እንዲህም ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «አባቴ ሆይ፣ የሚቻል ከሆነ ይህን የመከራ ጽዋ እንድጠጣ አታድርገኝ። ነገር ግን እኔ የምፈልገውን ሳይሆን አንተ የምትፈልገውን አድርግ።»

decisions.choice: this cup: the suffering and death before him, as God's judgment on sin
decisions.reason: In the prophets the cup stands for God's anger poured out (Isaiah 51:17; Jeremiah 25:15). Jesus asked James and John whether they could drink his cup (20:22).

decisions.choice: fell on his face: lay face down in deep humility
decisions.reason: Lying face down was a posture of urgent prayer and submission.

decisions.choice: not as I will, but as you will: the verb is supplied from the first half
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves out the second "will". Jesus submits his will to his Father's.

decisions.choice: do not make me drink this cup of suffering
alternatives: let this cup pass from me
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the cup.

decisions.choice: Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}
decisions.reason: The English "My Father" begins the prayer and is capitalised either way, so it takes no span. Spanish addresses a person with the possessive after the noun ("Padre mío"), so "mío" takes the setting like any other "my" Jesus says of himself. The same in verse 42.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on the pronouns for the Father ("toi", "tu") and for Jesus ("mon", "moi", "me") in the prayer
alternatives: spans only where the English has them
decisions.reason: As in Mark 14:36: French marks every pronoun for God or Christ, including "mon" in "mon Père" and the object "me" at Readable, where the English "my" is not marked; "je" for Jesus takes no span, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}
decisions.reason: The English "My Father" begins the prayer and takes no span. Swahili puts the possessive after the noun, so "yangu" takes the setting like any other "my" Jesus says of himself. The same in verse 42.

decisions.choice: "Cha" for "you" and "Con" for "I/me", with no setting spans
decisions.reason: Jesus prays to the Father as in Mark 14:36 and John 17, calling him "Cha" and himself "Con"; these are nouns of address, always capitalised, so the English deity_pronoun spans have no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "Cha của Con ơi" (L); "Cha ơi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Matthew's "my Father"; Balanced and Readable use the warm vocative a son uses, which already says "my".

decisions.choice: Jesus prays in 합쇼체 with "저/제"; "나의 아버지" for "my Father" (26:39, 26:42)
decisions.reason: As the style guide settles for Jesus speaking to the Father, and as in the Korean Mark 14:36. "나의" is the form of address of prayer (as "나의 하나님" in Mark 15:34), where "저의 아버지" would sound stiff.

decisions.choice: [원하시는] ... [하십시오] (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is supplied from the first half (meaning decision); Korean needs it, and an imperative to close the prayer.

decisions.choice: tu, afasta, faças (tu forms), with {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}
decisions.reason: Jesus prays to his Father with "tu", the form of prayer (style §4); the pronoun for the Father carries the deity_pronoun span, as the English "You" does.

decisions.choice: "አባቴ ሆይ" with the familiar "you" ("አንተ")
decisions.reason: Prayer to God uses the familiar singular in Amharic Scripture and worship, the address the book uses for God throughout (docs/amharic-style.md section 4); it is closeness, not lack of respect.

source.text: καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ· Οὕτως οὐκ ἰσχύσατε μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι μετ’ ἐμοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: And he comes to the disciples and finds them sleeping, and says to the Peter, So not you were able one hour to watch with me?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes to the disciples and finds them sleeping, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to Peter, "So, you could not keep watch with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for one hour?
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came back to the disciples and found them asleep. He said to Peter, "So none of you could stay awake with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for even one hour?
en.R: Then Jesus went back to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, "Could you not stay awake with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for just one hour?

es.L: Y viene a los discípulos y los encuentra durmiendo, y dice a Pedro: «¿De modo que no {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} capaces de velar ni una hora conmigo?
es.B: Luego volvió adonde estaban los discípulos y los encontró dormidos. Le dijo a Pedro: «¿Así que ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} pudo mantenerse despierto conmigo ni una hora?
es.R: Después Jesús volvió adonde estaban {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} seguidores y los encontró durmiendo. Le dijo a Pedro: «¿No {{plural_you:pudieron quedarse|pudisteis quedaros}} despiertos conmigo ni una hora?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient vers les disciples et les trouve endormis, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit à Pierre : « Ainsi, vous n’avez pas eu la force de veiller une heure avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ?
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} revint vers les disciples et les trouva endormis. Il dit à Pierre : « Ainsi, aucun de vous n’a pu veiller avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, même une heure ?
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus est revenu vers {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a trouvés endormis. Il a dit à Pierre : « Vous n’avez pas pu rester éveillés avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pendant une heure seulement ?

sw.L: Kisha anawajia wanafunzi, anawakuta wamelala usingizi, na anamwambia Petro, "Hivyo basi, hamkuwa na uwezo wa kukaa macho saa moja pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}?
sw.B: Kisha alirudi kwa wanafunzi, akawakuta wamelala. Akamwambia Petro, "Ina maana hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyeweza kukaa macho pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwa saa moja tu?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alirudi kwa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akawakuta wamelala. Akamwambia Petro, "Hamkuweza kukaa macho pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} hata kwa saa moja?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với các môn đồ và thấy họ đang ngủ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với Phi-e-rơ: "Vậy mà các con không thể thức canh với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một giờ sao?
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại với các môn đồ và thấy họ đang ngủ. Ngài nói với Phi-e-rơ: "Các con không thể thức canh với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dù chỉ một giờ sao?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu trở lại với các môn đồ và thấy họ đang ngủ. Ngài nói với Phi-e-rơ: "Các con không thể thức với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dù chỉ một giờ sao?

ko.L: 그리고 제자들에게 오셔서 그들이 자고 있는 것을 보신다. 그리고 베드로에게 말씀하신다. "이렇게 너희가 나와 함께 한 시간도 깨어 있을 수 없었느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 제자들에게 돌아와 보시니 그들은 자고 있었다. 예수께서 베드로에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 단 한 시간도 나와 함께 깨어 있을 수 없었느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 돌아와 보시니 그들은 자고 있었다. 예수께서 베드로에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 겨우 한 시간도 나와 함께 깨어 있지 못했느냐?

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem aos discípulos e os encontra dormindo, e diz a Pedro: "Então vocês não conseguiram vigiar {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} uma só hora?
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltou aos discípulos e os encontrou dormindo. Ele disse a Pedro: "Então nenhum de vocês conseguiu ficar acordado {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} nem uma hora?
pt.R: Depois Jesus voltou para os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores e os encontrou dormindo. Ele disse a Pedro: "Vocês não conseguiram ficar acordados {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} nem uma hora?

am.L: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይመጣል፤ ተኝተውም ያገኛቸዋል፤ ጴጥሮስንም እንዲህ ይለዋል፦ «እንዲህ ከእኔ ጋር አንዲት ሰዓት መንቃት አቃታችሁ?
am.B: ከዚያም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተመልሶ ተኝተው አገኛቸው። ጴጥሮስንም እንዲህ አለው፦ «ታዲያ ከእናንተ አንዳችሁ እንኳ ከእኔ ጋር ለአንድ ሰዓት መንቃት አልቻላችሁም?
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተመለሰ፤ ተኝተውም አገኛቸው። ጴጥሮስንም እንዲህ አለው፦ «ከእኔ ጋር ለአንድ ሰዓት ብቻ እንኳ ነቅታችሁ መቆየት አልቻላችሁም?

decisions.choice: you could not: plural, spoken to Peter for all three
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Peter, who had boasted (26:33-35), but the verb is plural.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: none of you
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the "you" is plural.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} (L); {{plural_you:pudieron quedarse|pudisteis quedaros}} (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Peter, but the verb is plural: he means all three (meaning decision m1). So it is the ustedes / vosotros setting, not "tú". Balanced says "ninguno de ustedes", as the English "none of you" does.

decisions.choice: vous (every level), though Jesus speaks to Peter
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is plural: Jesus speaks to Peter for all three (m1). French "vous" shows that at once, so Literal and Readable need no added words; Balanced says "aucun de vous", as the English "none of you".

decisions.choice: "các con", plural, though Jesus speaks to Peter
decisions.reason: The verb is plural (meaning decision): Jesus speaks to Peter for all three, so Vietnamese says "các con" as the next verse does.

decisions.choice: "너희" at every level; "한 시간" for "one hour"
decisions.reason: The verb is plural, spoken to Peter for all three (meaning decision), so Korean says "너희" and needs nothing added. Here hora is a length of time, not the appointed hour of 26:45, as in the Korean Mark 14:37.

decisions.choice: vocês
decisions.reason: The verb is plural though spoken to Peter (m1). Portuguese "vocês" shows that at every level, where English "you" cannot; Balanced keeps "nenhum de vocês", as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: the plural "አቃታችሁ", "አልቻላችሁም" (you all could not)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Peter but the Greek verb is plural, taking in all three (meaning decision m1). English "you" can hide this; Amharic must choose, and keeps the plural at every level.

source.text: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν· τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.

records.literal_gloss: Watch and pray, that not you enter into temptation; the indeed spirit willing, the but flesh weak.

en.L: Keep watch and pray, so that you may not enter into temptation; the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
en.B: Stay alert and pray that you will not come into testing. The spirit is eager, but human nature is weak."
en.R: Stay awake and pray, so that you will not fail when you are tested. Your spirit wants to do what is right, but your human nature is weak."

es.L: {{plural_you:Vigilen|Vigilad}} y {{plural_you:oren|orad}}, para que no {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} en tentación; el espíritu, en verdad, [está] deseoso, pero la carne [es] débil».
es.B: {{plural_you:Manténganse|Manteneos}} alerta y {{plural_you:oren|orad}} para que no {{plural_you:caigan|caigáis}} en la prueba. El espíritu tiene buena voluntad, pero la naturaleza humana es débil».
es.R: {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} despiertos y {{plural_you:oren|orad}}, para que no {{plural_you:fallen|falléis}} cuando {{plural_you:sean probados|seáis probados}}. {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} espíritu quiere hacer lo correcto, pero {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} naturaleza humana es débil».

fr.L: Veillez et priez, afin que vous n’entriez pas en tentation ; l’esprit, certes, [est] ardent, mais la chair [est] faible. »
fr.B: Veillez et priez, pour ne pas entrer dans l’épreuve. L’esprit est plein d’ardeur, mais la chair est faible. »
fr.R: Restez éveillés et priez. Alors vous ne tomberez pas quand l’épreuve viendra. Votre esprit veut faire ce qui est bien, mais votre nature humaine est faible. »

sw.L: Kaeni macho na mwombe, ili msiingie katika majaribu; roho kweli ina shauku, lakini mwili ni dhaifu."
sw.B: Kaeni macho na mwombe kwamba msiingie katika kujaribiwa. Roho ina shauku, lakini hali ya kibinadamu ni dhaifu."
sw.R: Kaeni macho na mwombe, ili msishindwe mnapojaribiwa. Roho zenu zinataka kufanya lililo sawa, lakini hali yenu ya kibinadamu ni dhaifu."

vi.L: Hãy thức canh và cầu nguyện, để các con không sa vào cám dỗ; tâm linh thì sẵn sàng, nhưng xác thịt thì yếu đuối."
vi.B: Hãy thức canh và cầu nguyện, để các con không rơi vào cám dỗ. Tâm linh thì hăng hái, nhưng thể xác thì yếu đuối."
vi.R: Hãy thức canh và cầu nguyện, để các con không chịu thua khi bị cám dỗ. Tâm hồn các con muốn làm điều đúng, nhưng thân thể các con thì yếu đuối."

ko.L: 깨어 있으면서 기도하여라. 그래야 너희가 시험에 빠지지 않을 것이다. 영은 하고자 하나, 육신은 약하다."
ko.B: 깨어 있으면서 시험에 빠지지 않도록 기도하여라. 영은 기꺼이 하려 하지만, 육신이 약하다."
ko.R: 깨어 있으면서 기도하여라. 그래야 시험이 닥칠 때 넘어가지 않는다. 너희 마음은 옳은 일을 하고 싶어 하지만, 너희 몸은 약하다."

pt.L: Vigiem e orem, para que não entrem em tentação; o espírito, de fato, [está] disposto, mas a carne [é] fraca."
pt.B: Fiquem atentos e orem, para que não entrem em provação. O espírito está disposto, mas a carne é fraca."
pt.R: Fiquem acordados e orem, para que vocês não falhem quando forem postos à prova. O espírito de vocês quer fazer o que é certo, mas a natureza humana de vocês é fraca."

am.L: ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ንቁ፤ ጸልዩም፤ መንፈስ ፈቃደኛ ነው፤ ሥጋ ግን ደካማ ነው።»
am.B: ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ንቁ፤ ጸልዩም። መንፈስ ዝግጁ ነው፤ ሥጋ ግን ደካማ ነው።»
am.R: በፈተና ጊዜ እንዳትወድቁ ንቁ፤ ጸልዩም። መንፈሳችሁ ትክክለኛውን ነገር ለማድረግ ይፈልጋል፤ የሰው ተፈጥሮአችሁ ግን ደካማ ነው።»

decisions.choice: temptation: testing, a trial that could lead them to fall away
decisions.reason: As in the Lord's Prayer (6:13). The test that night is whether they will stand by Jesus.

decisions.choice: the spirit and the flesh: the willing human spirit and weak human nature
alternatives: God's Spirit and the human body
decisions.reason: The disciples truly mean their promises (26:35), but they are frail. Some take "spirit" as the Spirit God gives (Psalm 51:12).

decisions.choice: testing (B); fail when you are tested (R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:13, Balanced and Readable use the wider word; Literal keeps the traditional one.

decisions.choice: human nature
decisions.reason: "Flesh" here means human weakness, not the body alone.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} espíritu ... {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} naturaleza
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "your spirit", "your human nature". In Spanish the possessive changes with the setting and, with vosotros, agrees with the noun ("vuestro espíritu", "vuestra naturaleza"), so each takes its own span.

decisions.choice: la tentation (L), l’épreuve (B, R); la chair (L, B), votre nature humaine (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "l’épreuve" for the wider sense (m1), as the English "testing". The term sheet keeps "la chair" at Balanced as well as Literal, as in Mark 14:38, where English Balanced says "human nature"; Readable follows the English and the meaning decision (m2).

decisions.choice: "cám dỗ" for peirasmos
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 14:38: the meaning decision describes a test that could make them fall, which "cám dỗ" names; "thử thách" would be any hardship.

decisions.choice: "시험" for peirasmos; "영 ... 육신" (L, B); "마음 ... 몸" (R)
decisions.reason: Word for word as the Korean Mark 14:38, where the Greek is nearly the same: "시험" covers both testing and temptation (meaning decision), and Readable says spirit and flesh in everyday words.

decisions.choice: a carne
decisions.reason: Style §6 keeps "a carne" at Balanced; in Portuguese "a carne é fraca" is a living saying for human weakness, so the sense of the meaning decision is clear without the English Balanced's change. Readable says "a natureza humana", as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: provação
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced "testing": "provação" is a trial that tests someone, the wider sense of m1; Literal keeps "tentação".

decisions.choice: "ሥጋ" (flesh, L, B); "የሰው ተፈጥሮአችሁ" (your human nature, R)
alternatives: "የሰው ባሕርይ" at Balanced, as the English "human nature"
decisions.reason: In Amharic "ሥጋ" set against "መንፈስ" already means weak human nature, a sense every reader knows, so Balanced keeps it; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

source.text: πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο λέγων· Πάτερ μου, εἰ οὐ δύναται τοῦτο παρελθεῖν ἐὰν μὴ αὐτὸ πίω, γενηθήτω τὸ θέλημά σου.

records.literal_gloss: Again for a second time having gone away he prayed saying, Father of me, if not is possible this to pass if not it I drink, let be done the will of you.

en.L: Again, for a second time, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went away and prayed, saying, "My Father, if this cannot pass unless I drink it, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will be done."
en.B: He went away again, a second time, and prayed: "My Father, if there is no way for this to pass unless I drink it, then let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will be done."
en.R: Jesus went away a second time and prayed, "My Father, if I must drink this cup of suffering, then let what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want be done."

es.L: De nuevo, por segunda vez, se fue y oró diciendo: «Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, si esto no puede pasar sin que yo lo beba, hágase {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad».
es.B: Se apartó otra vez, por segunda vez, y oró: «Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, si no hay manera de que esto pase sin que yo lo beba, entonces, hágase {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad».
es.R: Jesús se fue por segunda vez y oró: «Padre {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, si tengo que beber esta copa de sufrimiento, entonces que se haga lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres».

fr.L: De nouveau, pour la deuxième fois, s’en étant allé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pria, disant : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, si cela ne peut passer sans que je le boive, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté soit faite. »
fr.B: Il s’éloigna une deuxième fois et pria : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, s’il n’est pas possible que cela passe sans que je le boive, alors que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté soit faite. »
fr.R: Jésus s’est éloigné une deuxième fois et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prié : « {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, si je dois boire cette coupe de souffrance, alors que ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux se fasse. »

sw.L: Tena, mara ya pili, alienda kando akaomba, akisema, "Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kama hiki hakiwezi kupita nisipokinywa, mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yafanyike."
sw.B: Alienda kando tena mara ya pili, akaomba, "Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ikiwa hakuna njia ya hiki kupita nisipokinywa, basi mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yafanyike."
sw.R: Yesu alikwenda kando mara ya pili, akaomba, "Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ikiwa ni lazima ninywe kikombe hiki cha mateso, basi na yafanyike yale unayotaka {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}."

vi.L: Lại lần thứ hai, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi ra cầu nguyện và nói: "Cha của Con ơi, nếu chén này không thể qua đi mà Con không uống, thì nguyện ý muốn Cha được thực hiện."
vi.B: Ngài lại đi ra lần thứ hai và cầu nguyện: "Cha ơi, nếu chén này không thể lìa khỏi Con mà Con không uống, thì nguyện ý muốn Cha được thực hiện."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đi ra lần thứ hai và cầu nguyện: "Cha ơi, nếu Con phải uống chén đau khổ này, thì xin cho ý muốn Cha được thực hiện."

ko.L: 다시 두 번째로 가셔서 기도하며 말씀하셨다. "나의 아버지, 제가 이것을 마시지 않고는 이것이 지나갈 수 없다면, 아버지의 뜻이 이루어지게 하십시오."
ko.B: 예수께서 다시 두 번째로 가서 기도하셨다. "나의 아버지, 제가 이것을 마시지 않고는 이것이 비켜 갈 수 없다면, 아버지의 뜻이 이루어지기를 빕니다."
ko.R: 예수께서 다시 가서 두 번째로 기도하셨다. "나의 아버지, 제가 이 고난의 잔을 꼭 마셔야 한다면, 아버지께서 원하시는 대로 되게 해 주십시오."

pt.L: De novo, pela segunda vez, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou e orou, dizendo: "Meu Pai, se isto não pode passar sem que eu o beba, seja feita a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade."
pt.B: Ele se afastou outra vez, pela segunda vez, e orou: "Meu Pai, se não há como isto passar sem que eu o beba, então seja feita a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade."
pt.R: Jesus se afastou pela segunda vez e orou: "Meu Pai, se eu preciso beber este cálice de sofrimento, então que seja feito o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres."

am.L: ደግሞም ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ሄዶ እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «አባቴ ሆይ፣ ይህ ሳልጠጣው ማለፍ የማይቻል ከሆነ ፈቃድህ ይሁን።»
am.B: እንደገና ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ሄዶ እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «አባቴ ሆይ፣ ይህ ሳልጠጣው የሚያልፍበት መንገድ ከሌለ፣ ፈቃድህ ይሁን።»
am.R: ኢየሱስ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ሄዶ እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «አባቴ ሆይ፣ ይህን የመከራ ጽዋ መጠጣት ካለብኝ፣ አንተ የምትፈልገው ይሁን።»

decisions.choice: let your will be done: the words of the Lord's Prayer
decisions.reason: Jesus prays the words he taught his disciples (6:10).

decisions.choice: this, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: this cup, and from me, in many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "cup" and "from me", as in 26:39. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: if I must drink this cup of suffering
alternatives: if this cannot pass unless I drink it
decisions.reason: Readable states the condition positively and names the cup of 26:39.

decisions.choice: hágase tu voluntad
decisions.reason: These are the words of the Lord's Prayer (6:10; meaning decision m1). Literal and Balanced keep the form of the petition so the echo is heard; the Spanish of 6:10 should use the same words when it is drafted. Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mapenzi yako yafanyike
decisions.reason: These are the words of the Lord's Prayer (6:10; meaning decision m1). Literal and Balanced keep the form of the petition so the echo is heard; the Swahili of 6:10 should use the same words when it is drafted. Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nguyện ý muốn Cha được thực hiện" (L, B); "xin cho ý muốn Cha được thực hiện" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Lord's Prayer (meaning decision), worded as in the Vietnamese Matthew 6:10 so that the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: "아버지의 뜻이 이루어지게 하십시오" (L); "아버지의 뜻이 이루어지기를 빕니다" (B)
decisions.reason: The words of the Lord's Prayer (meaning decision): Literal and Balanced use the very wording of the Korean Matthew 6:10 at each level, so the echo is heard.

source.text: καὶ ἐλθὼν πάλιν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ βεβαρημένοι.

records.literal_gloss: And having come again he found them sleeping, were for of them the eyes weighed down.

en.L: And coming again, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came back, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} again found them asleep; they could not keep their eyes open.
en.R: When Jesus came back, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} found them sleeping again. They were too tired to keep their eyes open.

es.L: Y habiendo venido de nuevo, los encontró durmiendo, porque sus ojos estaban pesados.
es.B: Cuando volvió, los encontró otra vez dormidos; no podían mantener los ojos abiertos.
es.R: Cuando Jesús regresó, los encontró durmiendo otra vez. Estaban tan cansados que no podían tener los ojos abiertos.

fr.L: Et étant revenu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les trouva de nouveau endormis, car leurs yeux étaient appesantis.
fr.B: À {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} retour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les trouva encore endormis : ils ne pouvaient pas garder les yeux ouverts.
fr.R: Quand Jésus est revenu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a trouvés encore endormis. Ils étaient trop fatigués pour garder les yeux ouverts.

sw.L: Na aliporudi tena, aliwakuta wakiwa wamelala usingizi, maana macho yao yalikuwa yamelemewa.
sw.B: Aliporudi, aliwakuta tena wamelala; macho yao hayakuweza kukaa wazi.
sw.R: Yesu aliporudi, aliwakuta wamelala tena. Walikuwa wamechoka mno hata wasiweze kufumbua macho.

vi.L: Và trở lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại thấy họ đang ngủ, vì mắt họ nặng trĩu.
vi.B: Khi trở lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại thấy họ đang ngủ, vì họ không mở mắt nổi.
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu trở lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại thấy họ đang ngủ. Họ mệt đến nỗi không mở mắt ra được.

ko.L: 그리고 다시 오셔서 그들이 자고 있는 것을 보셨다. 그들의 눈이 무거워져 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 다시 와 보시니 그들은 또 자고 있었다. 그들은 눈을 뜨고 있을 수가 없었다.
ko.R: 예수께서 돌아와 보시니 제자들은 또 자고 있었다. 너무 졸려서 눈을 뜨고 있을 수가 없었던 것이다.

pt.L: E, vindo de novo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os encontrou dormindo, pois os olhos deles estavam pesados.
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltou, de novo os encontrou dormindo; eles não conseguiam manter os olhos abertos.
pt.R: Quando Jesus voltou, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os encontrou dormindo de novo. Eles estavam cansados demais para manter os olhos abertos.

am.L: ተመልሶም መጥቶ ተኝተው አገኛቸው፤ ዓይኖቻቸው ከብደው ነበርና።
am.B: ሲመለስም እንደገና ተኝተው አገኛቸው፤ ዓይኖቻቸውን መግለጥ አልቻሉም ነበር።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ሲመለስ እንደገና ተኝተው አገኛቸው። በጣም ደክመው ስለ ነበር ዓይኖቻቸውን መግለጥ አልቻሉም።

decisions.choice: their eyes were heavy: they were overcome by sleep
decisions.reason: A common way of saying that sleep had overpowered them.

source.text: καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο ἐκ τρίτου τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπὼν πάλιν.

records.literal_gloss: And having left them again having gone away he prayed a third time the same word having said again.

en.L: And leaving them again, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went away and prayed a third time, saying the same word again.
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left them, went away once more, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
en.R: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left them and went away again. He prayed a third time, saying the same thing.

es.L: Y, dejándolos, volvió a apartarse y oró por tercera vez, diciendo de nuevo la misma palabra.
es.B: Así que los dejó, se apartó una vez más y oró por tercera vez, con las mismas palabras.
es.R: Entonces los dejó y se fue otra vez. Oró por tercera vez y dijo lo mismo.

fr.L: Et les ayant laissés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’en alla de nouveau et pria pour la troisième fois, disant de nouveau la même parole.
fr.B: Il les laissa donc, s’éloigna encore et pria une troisième fois, en disant les mêmes paroles.
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a laissés et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est éloigné encore. Il a prié une troisième fois, avec les mêmes mots.

sw.L: Kisha, akiisha kuwaacha, alienda kando tena akaomba kwa mara ya tatu, akirudia neno lile lile.
sw.B: Basi aliwaacha, akaenda kando tena, akaomba kwa mara ya tatu, akitumia maneno yale yale.
sw.R: Basi aliwaacha, akaenda tena. Akaomba mara ya tatu, akisema mambo yale yale.

vi.L: Và để họ lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại đi ra và cầu nguyện lần thứ ba, nói lại cùng những lời ấy.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để họ lại, đi ra một lần nữa và cầu nguyện lần thứ ba, cũng bằng những lời như trước.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để họ ở đó và lại đi ra. Ngài cầu nguyện lần thứ ba, nói những điều giống như trước.

ko.L: 그리고 그들을 그대로 두고 다시 가셔서, 다시 같은 말씀을 하시며 세 번째로 기도하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 그들을 그대로 두고 다시 가셔서, 같은 말씀으로 세 번째 기도하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 제자들을 두고 다시 가셨다. 그리고 세 번째로 같은 기도를 드리셨다.

pt.L: E, deixando-os, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou de novo e orou pela terceira vez, dizendo de novo a mesma palavra.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os deixou, afastou-se mais uma vez e orou pela terceira vez, dizendo as mesmas palavras.
pt.R: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os deixou e se afastou de novo. Ele orou pela terceira vez, dizendo a mesma coisa.

am.L: ትቷቸውም እንደገና ሄዶ ያንኑ ቃል ደግሞ እየተናገረ ሦስተኛ ጊዜ ጸለየ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ትቷቸው እንደገና ሄደ፤ ያንኑ ቃል እየደገመም ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ ጸለየ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ትቷቸው እንደገና ሄደ። ያንኑ ነገር እየተናገረ ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ ጸለየ።

decisions.choice: the same word: the same prayer as before
decisions.reason: He prayed again as in 26:42.

source.text: τότε ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Καθεύδετε τὸ λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε· ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἁμαρτωλῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Then he comes to the disciples and says to them, Sleep the rest and take rest; behold, has drawn near the hour and the Son of the Man is handed over into hands of sinners.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes to the disciples and says to them, "Sleep on now and take your rest. Look, the hour has drawn near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into [the] hands of sinners.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came to the disciples and said to them, "Go on sleeping, then, and resting. The hour is here: the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came back to the followers and said to them, "Sleep on, then, and rest! But now the time has come. The Son of Man is being handed over to sinners.

es.L: Entonces viene a los discípulos y les dice: «{{plural_you:Duerman|Dormid}} lo que queda y {{plural_you:descansen|descansad}}. {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}: la hora se ha acercado, y el Hijo del Hombre es entregado en manos de pecadores.
es.B: Luego volvió adonde estaban los discípulos y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} durmiendo, pues, y {{plural_you:descansen|descansad}}. La hora ya está aquí: el Hijo del Hombre está siendo entregado en manos de pecadores.
es.R: Después volvió adonde estaban los seguidores y les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} durmiendo, pues, y {{plural_you:descansen|descansad}}! Pero ya llegó el momento. El Hijo del Hombre está siendo entregado a los pecadores.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient vers les disciples et leur dit : « Dormez maintenant et reposez-vous ! Voici, l’heure s’est approchée, et le Fils de l’homme est livré aux mains des pécheurs.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vint vers les disciples et leur dit : « Continuez donc à dormir et à vous reposer ! L’heure est là : le Fils de l’homme est livré aux mains des pécheurs.
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est revenu vers les disciples et leur a dit : « Dormez donc, reposez-vous ! Mais maintenant, le moment est arrivé. Le Fils de l’homme est livré à des pécheurs.

sw.L: Kisha anawaendea wanafunzi, anawaambia, "Endeleeni kulala na kupumzika; tazameni, saa imesogea karibu, na Mwana wa Adamu anatolewa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.
sw.B: Kisha aliwaendea wanafunzi, akawaambia, "Basi endeleeni kulala na kupumzika. Saa imefika: Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kukabidhiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.
sw.R: Kisha aliwarudia wanafunzi, akawaambia, "Haya, laleni na mpumzike! Lakini sasa wakati umefika. Mwana wa Adamu anakabidhiwa kwa wenye dhambi.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với các môn đồ và nói với họ: "Các con cứ ngủ và nghỉ ngơi đi! Kìa, giờ đã đến gần, và Con Người bị nộp vào tay những kẻ tội lỗi.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại với các môn đồ và nói với họ: "Thế thì cứ ngủ và nghỉ ngơi đi! Giờ đã đến: Con Người đang bị nộp vào tay những kẻ tội lỗi.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại với các môn đồ và nói với họ: "Thôi, cứ ngủ và nghỉ đi! Nhưng bây giờ đã đến lúc rồi. Con Người đang bị nộp vào tay những kẻ tội lỗi.

ko.L: 그때 제자들에게 오셔서 그들에게 말씀하신다. "이제는 자고 쉬어라. 보라, 때가 가까이 왔다. 인자가 죄인들의 손에 넘겨진다.
ko.B: 그리고 제자들에게 오셔서 말씀하셨다. "그래, 이제는 자고 쉬어라. 때가 왔다. 인자가 죄인들의 손에 넘겨지고 있다.
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 돌아오셔서 말씀하셨다. "그래, 계속 자면서 쉬어라! 그러나 이제 때가 왔다. 인자가 죄인들에게 넘겨지고 있다.

pt.L: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem aos discípulos e lhes diz: "Durmam agora e descansem. Vejam, chegou a hora, e o Filho do Homem é entregue nas mãos de pecadores.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltou aos discípulos e lhes disse: "Continuem dormindo, então, e descansando! A hora chegou: o Filho do Homem está sendo traído e entregue nas mãos de pecadores.
pt.R: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltou para junto dos seguidores e disse a eles: "Agora durmam e descansem! Mas chegou a hora. O Filho do Homem está sendo entregue aos pecadores.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይመጣል፤ እንዲህም ይላቸዋል፦ «እንግዲህ ተኙ፤ ዕረፉም፤ እነሆ፣ ሰዓቱ ቀርቧል፤ የሰው ልጅም በኃጢአተኞች እጅ ተላልፎ ይሰጣል።
am.B: ከዚያም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እንግዲያውስ ተኙ፤ ዕረፉም። ሰዓቱ ደርሷል፤ የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ ተላልፎ እየተሰጠ ነው።
am.R: ከዚያም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተመልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እንግዲያውስ ተኙ፤ ዕረፉ! አሁን ግን ጊዜው ደርሷል። የሰው ልጅ ለኃጢአተኞች ተላልፎ እየተሰጠ ነው።

decisions.choice: sleep on and rest: a command, spoken with sorrow or irony
alternatives: a question: Are you still sleeping and resting?
decisions.reason: The words can be read as a command or as a question; the SBLGNT punctuation reads them as a statement. Either way Jesus tells them the time for watching is past, and in 26:46 he rouses them.

decisions.choice: the hour: the appointed time of his suffering
decisions.reason: Compare "my time" in 26:18.

decisions.choice: sinners: those who do not keep God's law, here the men coming to arrest him
decisions.reason: The word may also look ahead to the Gentiles to whom he will be handed over (20:19).

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: es entregado (L); está siendo entregado (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "hand over", here into the hands of sinners. Literal says "entregar" for it throughout the chapter. The English Balanced says "betrayed into the hands of", but Spanish "traicionar" cannot take "en manos de", so Balanced says "entregado" here and "traicionar" in verses 46 and 48.

decisions.choice: est livré aux mains des pécheurs (L, B)
alternatives: est trahi et livré aux mains des pécheurs
decisions.reason: English Literal and Balanced say "betrayed into the hands of sinners", but French "trahir" cannot take "aux mains de"; "livrer aux mains de" is the natural phrase and keeps the word of Jesus's sayings (26:2), as in Mark 14:41. "Voici" stays at Literal, as set for the whole book at 1:20.

decisions.choice: anatolewa (L); anasalitiwa na kukabidhiwa (B); anakabidhiwa (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "hand over". Literal says "kutoa" for it throughout the chapter. Balanced says "betrayed" with the English, and adds "kukabidhiwa" because "kusaliti" cannot take "into the hands of"; Readable says "handed over", as the English does. The same verbs in verses 46 and 48.

decisions.choice: "cứ ngủ và nghỉ ngơi đi", a command
alternatives: a question, "Các con vẫn còn ngủ sao?" as in Mark 14:41
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as a command spoken with sorrow or irony; "cứ ... đi" carries that tone.

decisions.choice: "nộp" for paradidotai
decisions.reason: The verb Vietnamese keeps for "hand over" through the passion story, as in Mark 14:41 and 15:1; it covers both Judas's act and God's plan.

decisions.choice: "보라" (L) for idou, through Matthew 26-28, left out or carried by the sentence at Balanced and Readable; "때" for hora; "넘겨지다" for paradidotai
decisions.reason: "보라" is the Literal word for idou in the Korean Matthew (1:20; 17:5). As in the Korean Mark 14:41, "때" carries the appointed hour of his suffering (meaning decision), and the passive of "넘겨주다" keeps both God's plan and Judas' deed.

decisions.choice: é entregue (L); está sendo traído e entregue (B)
alternatives: é traído nas mãos de pecadores
decisions.reason: Portuguese cannot "betray into the hands" of someone: "trair" takes no such phrase. Literal uses the Greek verb's own sense, "entregar"; Balanced keeps the betrayal the English names and adds "entregue" to carry the phrase.

decisions.choice: "ተላልፎ ይሰጣል" (is handed over) at every level
alternatives: "ይከዳል" (is betrayed), as the English Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: "ተላልፎ መስጠት" / "አሳልፎ መስጠት", "to hand over", serves for every use of this verb in the Passion, and from a friend it already means betrayal; the same in 26:46 and 26:48.

source.text: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν· ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ὁ παραδιδούς με.

records.literal_gloss: Rise, let us go; behold, has drawn near the one handing over me.

en.L: Get up, let us go. Look, the [one] who is betraying {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has drawn near."
en.B: Get up; let us be going. Here comes the man who is betraying {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: Get up! Let us go. The one who is handing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} over is coming!"

es.L: {{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}, vámonos; {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, ya está cerca el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entrega».
es.B: {{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}; vámonos. Ahí viene el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traiciona».
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}! Vámonos. ¡Ya viene el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} va a entregar!».

fr.L: Levez-vous, allons ; voici, celui qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trahit s’est approché. »
fr.B: Levez-vous, allons-y. Voici que celui qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trahit arrive. »
fr.R: Levez-vous ! Allons-y. L’homme qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} livre arrive ! »

sw.L: Simameni, twende; tazameni, amekaribia yule anayenitoa."
sw.B: Simameni, twendeni. Huyu hapa anakuja yule anayenisaliti."
sw.R: Amkeni! Twendeni. Yule anayenikabidhi anakuja!"

vi.L: Hãy đứng dậy, chúng ta đi; kìa, kẻ nộp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đến gần."
vi.B: Hãy đứng dậy, chúng ta đi. Kìa, kẻ phản bội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đến."
vi.R: Hãy đứng dậy! Chúng ta đi thôi. Kẻ nộp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang đến kia!"

ko.L: 일어나라, 가자. 보라, 나를 넘겨주는 자가 가까이 왔다."
ko.B: 일어나라. 가자. 저기 나를 배반하는 자가 오고 있다."
ko.R: 일어나라! 가자. 나를 배반하는 사람이 오고 있다!"

pt.L: Levantem-se, vamos. Vejam, chegou aquele que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trai."
pt.B: Levantem-se, vamos embora. Aí vem o homem que está {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traindo."
pt.R: Levantem-se! Vamos. Aquele que vai {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entregar está chegando!"

am.L: ተነሡ፤ እንሂድ፤ እነሆ፣ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ ቀርቧል።»
am.B: ተነሡ፤ እንሂድ። አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ ሰው ይኸው መጣ።»
am.R: ተነሡ! እንሂድ። አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ እየመጣ ነው!»

decisions.choice: let us go: go to meet them
decisions.reason: Jesus does not flee; he goes out to face the one who betrays him.

decisions.choice: look (L); here comes (B); not rendered (R) (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: "kẻ nộp Ta" (L, R); "kẻ phản bội Ta" (B)
decisions.reason: As the English: Balanced names Judas's act as betrayal, as the Vietnamese Mark 14:42 does; Literal and Readable keep the plain "hand over".

decisions.choice: "넘겨주는 자" (L); "배반하는 자/사람" (B, R) for ho paradidous, here and in 26:48
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:42 and 14:44: Literal keeps the verb of handing over; Balanced and Readable name what Judas does to his teacher.

source.text: Καὶ ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ἦλθεν καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὄχλος πολὺς μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And still of him speaking, behold, Judas one of the twelve came, and with him a crowd great with swords and clubs from the chief priests and elders of the people.

en.L: And while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still speaking, look, Judas, one of the Twelve, came, and with him a large crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
en.B: Jesus had not finished speaking when Judas, one of the Twelve, came up. A large crowd came with him, carrying swords and clubs. The chief priests and the elders of the people had sent them.
en.R: Jesus was still talking when Judas came. He was one of the twelve followers. A big crowd came with him. They carried swords and wooden clubs. The leading priests and older leaders of the people had sent them.

es.L: Y mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todavía hablaba, mira, llegó Judas, uno de los Doce, y con él una gran turba con espadas y garrotes, de parte de los principales sacerdotes y de los ancianos del pueblo.
es.B: Jesús todavía estaba hablando cuando llegó Judas, uno de los Doce. Con él venía una gran multitud armada con espadas y garrotes. Los habían enviado los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos del pueblo.
es.R: Jesús todavía estaba hablando cuando llegó Judas. Era uno de los doce seguidores. Con él venía mucha gente. Traían espadas y palos. Los habían enviado los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos que dirigían al pueblo.

fr.L: Et comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlait encore, voici, Judas, l’un des Douze, arriva, et avec lui une grande foule avec des épées et des bâtons, de la part des chefs des prêtres et des anciens du peuple.
fr.B: Jésus parlait encore quand Judas, l’un des Douze, arriva. Une grande foule l’accompagnait, armée d’épées et de bâtons. Les chefs des prêtres et les anciens du peuple les avaient envoyés.
fr.R: Jésus parlait encore quand Judas est arrivé. C’était l’un des douze disciples. Une grande foule est venue avec lui. Ces gens avaient des épées et de gros bâtons. Les chefs des prêtres et les anciens qui dirigeaient le peuple les avaient envoyés.

sw.L: Na akiwa bado anazungumza, tazama, Yuda alifika, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, na kundi kubwa la watu pamoja naye, wakiwa na panga na virungu, wametumwa na wakuu wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.
sw.B: Yesu alikuwa bado anazungumza Yuda alipofika, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili. Kundi kubwa la watu lilikuja pamoja naye, wakiwa wamebeba panga na virungu. Wakuu wa makuhani na wazee wa watu ndio waliowatuma.
sw.R: Yesu alipokuwa bado anaongea, Yuda alifika. Yeye alikuwa mmoja wa wanafunzi kumi na wawili. Kundi kubwa la watu lilikuja pamoja naye. Walibeba panga na virungu vya mbao. Wakuu wa makuhani na wazee waliowaongoza watu ndio waliowatuma.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đang nói, kìa, Giu-đa, một trong [nhóm] Mười Hai, đến, và cùng với ông ta có một đám đông lớn mang gươm và gậy, từ các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão của dân [sai đến].
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đang nói, Giu-đa, một trong nhóm Mười Hai, đến. Đi cùng ông ta có một đám đông lớn mang gươm và gậy, do các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão trong dân sai đến.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu còn đang nói thì Giu-đa đến. Ông ta là một trong mười hai môn đồ. Có một đám đông lớn đi cùng ông ta. Họ mang theo gươm và gậy gộc. Các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão trong dân đã sai họ đến.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 보라, 열둘 가운데 하나인 유다가 왔다. 그리고 그와 함께 칼과 몽둥이를 든 큰 무리가 대제사장들과 백성의 장로들에게서 [왔다].
ko.B: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 열두 제자 가운데 하나인 유다가 왔다. 칼과 몽둥이를 든 큰 무리가 그와 함께 왔는데, 대제사장들과 백성의 장로들이 보낸 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에 유다가 왔다. 유다는 열두 제자 가운데 하나였다. 많은 사람이 유다와 함께 왔다. 그들은 칼과 몽둥이를 들고 있었다. 대제사장들과 백성의 지도자들이 그들을 보낸 것이다.

pt.L: E, enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ainda falava, eis que Judas, um dos Doze, chegou, e com ele uma grande multidão com espadas e porretes, da parte dos chefes dos sacerdotes e anciãos do povo.
pt.B: Jesus ainda estava falando quando chegou Judas, um dos Doze. Com ele veio uma grande multidão, armada de espadas e porretes. Os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo os tinham enviado.
pt.R: Jesus ainda estava falando quando Judas chegou. Ele era um dos doze seguidores. Uma multidão grande veio com ele. Eles levavam espadas e porretes. Os chefes dos sacerdotes e os líderes mais velhos do povo tinham mandado aquela gente.

am.L: ገናም እርሱ ሲናገር፣ እነሆ፣ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ይሁዳ መጣ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ሰይፍና ዱላ የያዙ ብዙ ሕዝብ ከካህናት አለቆችና ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎች ዘንድ [መጡ]።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ገና ንግግሩን ሳይጨርስ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ የሆነው ይሁዳ ደረሰ። ከእርሱም ጋር ሰይፍና ዱላ የያዙ ብዙ ሰዎች መጡ። የላኳቸውም የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ገና እየተናገረ ሳለ ይሁዳ መጣ። እርሱ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዱ ነበር። ብዙ ሕዝብም ከእርሱ ጋር መጣ። ሰይፍና የእንጨት ዱላ ይዘው ነበር። የላኳቸውም የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎች ነበሩ።

decisions.choice: a large crowd with swords and clubs: an armed band, probably the temple guard and servants of the chief priests
decisions.reason: They were sent by the chief priests, and the high priest's slave was among them (26:51). John 18:3 also mentions soldiers.

decisions.choice: one of the Twelve: Matthew stresses that the betrayer was one of his own
decisions.reason: Matthew has already told the reader who Judas is (10:4; 26:14). Repeating it here underlines the betrayal.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: the chief priests had sent them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "from" means.

decisions.choice: los principales sacerdotes (L), los jefes de los sacerdotes (B, R); los ancianos del pueblo (L, B), los ancianos que dirigían al pueblo (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used for these groups throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Literal keeps the traditional title for the chief priests, as Mark and John do; Balanced and Readable say plainly that they were the heads of the priesthood.

decisions.choice: panga (swords), virungu (clubs); wakuu wa makuhani; wazee wa watu (L, B), wazee waliowaongoza watu (R)
decisions.reason: "Panga" is the plural of "upanga", the sword, as in 26:51-52; "mapanga" would be machetes. The terms for the chief priests and elders are those used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage.

decisions.choice: "các trưởng lão của dân" (L); "trong dân" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The elders of the people, members of the council with the chief priests, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:43; the word is plain enough to keep at Readable.

decisions.choice: "열둘" (L), "열두 제자" (B, R); "대제사장들" at every level; "백성의 장로들" (L, B), "백성의 지도자들" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms settled for the Korean Gospels and used in the Korean Mark 14:43 and 15:1.

decisions.choice: [왔다] (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb for the crowd; Korean needs one.

decisions.choice: eis que (in narration)
decisions.reason: In speech Literal says "Vejam" (26:45, 46), as the English says "look"; in the narrator's voice a command to the reader reads oddly in Portuguese, and "eis que", still used in written narrative, carries the word's force. Likewise in 26:51.

source.text: ὁ δὲ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς σημεῖον λέγων· Ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν· κρατήσατε αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] and handing over him gave them a sign saying, Whom ever I kiss, he is; seize him.

en.L: Now the [one] betraying {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} had given them a sign, saying, "Whomever I kiss, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is [the one]; seize {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: The betrayer had given them a sign: "The man I kiss is the one you want. Arrest {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Judas had given them a sign so they would know which man was Jesus. He had said, "The man I kiss is the one you want. Arrest {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Y el que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregaba les había dado una señal, diciendo: «Al que yo bese, es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; {{plural_you:agárrenlo|agarradlo}}».
es.B: El traidor les había dado una contraseña: «Al que yo bese, ese es el que {{plural_you:buscan|buscáis}}. {{plural_you:Arréstenlo|Arrestadlo}}».
es.R: Judas les había dado una señal para que supieran cuál de ellos era Jesús. Les había dicho: «El hombre al que yo bese es el que {{plural_you:buscan|buscáis}}. {{plural_you:Arréstenlo|Arrestadlo}}».

fr.L: Or celui qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trahissait leur avait donné un signe, disant : « Celui que j’embrasserai, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; saisissez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. »
fr.B: Le traître leur avait donné un signal : « Celui que j’embrasserai, c’est celui que vous cherchez. Arrêtez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. »
fr.R: Judas leur avait donné un signe pour qu’ils sachent qui était Jésus. Il avait dit : « L’homme que j’embrasserai, c’est celui que vous cherchez. Arrêtez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. »

sw.L: Basi yule anayemtoa alikuwa amewapa ishara, akisema, "Yeyote nitakayembusu, ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}; mshikeni."
sw.B: Msaliti huyo alikuwa amewapa ishara: "Mtu nitakayembusu ndiye mnayemtafuta. Mkamateni."
sw.R: Yuda alikuwa amewapa ishara ili wajue ni nani kati yao aliyekuwa Yesu. Alikuwa amesema, "Mtu nitakayembusu ndiye mnayemtaka. Mkamateni."

vi.L: Vả, kẻ nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho họ một dấu hiệu, rằng: "Người nào tôi hôn, chính là người ấy; hãy bắt lấy người ấy."
vi.B: Kẻ phản bội đã cho họ một ám hiệu từ trước: "Người nào tôi hôn chính là người đó. Hãy bắt lấy người đó."
vi.R: Giu-đa đã dặn trước để họ biết ai là Đức Giê-xu. Ông ta nói: "Người nào tôi hôn chính là người các anh muốn bắt. Hãy bắt lấy người đó."

ko.L: 그런데 그분을 넘겨주는 자가 그들에게 신호를 주며 말했었다. "내가 입 맞추는 사람이 바로 그 사람이다. 그를 붙잡아라."
ko.B: 예수를 배반하는 자는 미리 그들에게 신호를 정해 두었다. "내가 입을 맞추는 사람이 바로 그 사람이다. 그를 붙잡아라."
ko.R: 유다는 어떤 사람이 예수인지 알아볼 수 있도록 미리 그들에게 신호를 정해 주었다. "내가 입을 맞추는 사람이 바로 너희가 찾는 사람이다. 그를 붙잡아라."

pt.L: E o que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} traía lhes tinha dado um sinal, dizendo: "Aquele que eu beijar, é {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}; prendam-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}."
pt.B: O traidor tinha combinado um sinal com eles: "O homem que eu beijar é quem vocês procuram. Prendam-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}."
pt.R: Judas tinha dado um sinal a eles para que soubessem qual homem era Jesus. Ele tinha dito: "O homem que eu beijar é aquele que vocês querem. Prendam-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}."

am.L: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም፦ «የምስመው እርሱ ነው፤ ያዙት።» ብሎ ምልክት ሰጥቷቸው ነበር።
am.B: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም፦ «የምስመው ሰው የምትፈልጉት እርሱ ነው፤ ያዙት።» ብሎ ምልክት ሰጥቷቸው ነበር።
am.R: ይሁዳ ኢየሱስ የትኛው እንደሆነ እንዲያውቁ ምልክት ሰጥቷቸው ነበር። እንዲህ ብሏቸው ነበር፦ «የምስመው ሰው የምትፈልጉት እርሱ ነው። ያዙት።»

decisions.choice: kiss: the usual greeting of a disciple for his teacher
decisions.reason: A kiss was an ordinary sign of respect. In the dark and among many disciples, the armed band needed a way to know Jesus.

decisions.choice: had given: the sign was arranged beforehand
decisions.reason: The Greek past tense here describes something done earlier.

decisions.choice: so they would know which man was Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sign was for.

decisions.choice: "người ấy", "người đó" in Judas's words, with no setting span
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 14:44: Judas, handing Jesus over, would not speak of him with the reverent "Ngài"; the plain words have no capital form for the setting.

decisions.choice: Judas speaks of Jesus as "그 사람", "그" with no honorific
decisions.reason: Judas gives orders to the arresting crowd; the narrative keeps its honorific for Jesus, but Judas' words do not, as in the Korean Mark 14:44.

source.text: καὶ εὐθέως προσελθὼν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπεν· Χαῖρε, ῥαββί· καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately having come to the Jesus he said, Greetings, rabbi, and kissed him.

en.L: And immediately coming up to Jesus, he said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Judas went straight to Jesus and said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" Then he kissed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Judas went right up to Jesus and said, "Hello, Teacher!" Then he kissed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y al instante se acercó a Jesús y dijo: «¡Saludos, Rabí!», y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} besó.
es.B: Judas fue directamente hacia Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «¡Saludos, Rabí!». Luego {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} besó.
es.R: Judas se acercó enseguida a Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «¡Hola, Maestro!». Luego {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} besó.

fr.L: Et aussitôt, s’étant approché de Jésus, il dit : « Je te salue, Rabbi ! » et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}embrassa.
fr.B: Aussitôt, Judas alla droit à Jésus et dit : « Je te salue, Rabbi ! » Puis il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}embrassa.
fr.R: Judas est allé tout droit vers Jésus et il a dit : « Bonjour, Maître ! » Puis il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a embrassé.

sw.L: Na papo hapo alimsogelea Yesu, akasema, "Nakusalimu, Rabi!" na kumbusu.
sw.B: Yuda alimwendea Yesu moja kwa moja, akasema, "Nakusalimu, Rabi!" Kisha akambusu.
sw.R: Yuda alimwendea Yesu mara moja, akasema, "Hujambo, Mwalimu!" Kisha akambusu.

vi.L: Và lập tức đến gần Đức Giê-xu, ông ta nói: "Chào Ra-bi!" rồi hôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Giu-đa đi thẳng đến Đức Giê-xu và nói: "Chào Ra-bi!" Rồi ông ta hôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Giu-đa đi thẳng đến chỗ Đức Giê-xu và nói: "Chào Thầy!" Rồi ông ta hôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 예수께 다가와서 "랍비, 안녕하십니까?" 하고 말하고는 그분께 입을 맞추었다.
ko.B: 유다는 곧바로 예수께 다가가서 "랍비님, 안녕하십니까?" 하고 인사하고는 입을 맞추었다.
ko.R: 유다는 바로 예수께 다가갔다. 그리고 "랍비님, 안녕하십니까?" 하고 인사하며 예수께 입을 맞추었다.

pt.L: E logo, aproximando-se de Jesus, disse: "Salve, Rabi!" e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} beijou.
pt.B: Judas foi direto até Jesus e disse: "Salve, Rabi!" Depois {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} beijou.
pt.R: Judas foi direto até Jesus e disse: "Olá, Mestre!" Depois deu um beijo {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.

am.L: ወዲያውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀርቦ፦ «ሰላም፣ ረቢ!» አለ፤ ሳመውም።
am.B: ይሁዳ በቀጥታ ወደ ኢየሱስ ሄዶ፦ «ሰላም፣ ረቢ!» አለው። ከዚያም ሳመው።
am.R: ይሁዳ በቀጥታ ወደ ኢየሱስ ሄዶ፦ «ሰላም፣ መምህር!» አለው። ከዚያም ሳመው።

decisions.choice: kissed him: perhaps kissed him warmly
decisions.reason: The verb is a stronger form of the one in 26:48. It may only mean that he carried out the sign.

decisions.choice: Rabbi: as in 26:25
decisions.reason: Judas again uses the title the others avoid.

decisions.choice: Hello, Teacher
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday greeting and gives the title's meaning, as in 26:25.

decisions.choice: Je te salue, Rabbi (L, B); Bonjour, Maître (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary greeting. French "Salut" is now casual, and "Réjouis-toi" would read as a call to joy, so Literal and Balanced use the formal "Je te salue". Readable uses the everyday greeting and the title "Maître", as in 26:25, where the English says "Hello, Teacher". Judas says "tu" to Jesus, as everyone does; the pronoun in his greeting is not marked, as the English "you" in 26:25 is.

decisions.choice: "Chào Ra-bi" (L, B); "Chào Thầy" (R)
decisions.reason: A greeting with "Ra-bi", as in Matthew 26:25 and Mark 14:45; Readable gives the meaning of the title, as the English Readable says "Teacher".

decisions.choice: "랍비" (L), "랍비님" (B, R); "안녕하십니까" for chaire
decisions.reason: The address as the Korean style guide gives it and as in the Korean Mark 14:45. Judas greets Jesus in the polite form a disciple uses, which makes the betrayal plain; "평안하십니까" is older.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἑταῖρε, ἐφ’ ὃ πάρει.

records.literal_gloss: The and Jesus said to him, Friend, for what you are here.

en.L: And Jesus said to him, "Friend, [do] that for which you have come."
en.B: Jesus said to him, "Friend, get on with what you are here for."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Friend, do what you came here to do."

es.L: Y Jesús le dijo: «Amigo, [haz] aquello a lo que has venido».
es.B: Jesús le dijo: «Amigo, lleva a cabo aquello a lo que has venido».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Amigo, haz lo que viniste a hacer».

fr.L: Mais Jésus lui dit : « Ami, [fais] ce pour quoi tu es là. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Mon ami, va jusqu’au bout de ce que tu es venu faire. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Mon ami, fais ce que tu es venu faire ici. »

sw.L: Na Yesu akamwambia, "Mwenzangu, [timiza] lile ambalo umekuja kwa ajili yake."
sw.B: Yesu akamwambia, "Mwenzangu, endelea na kile ulichokuja kufanya."
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia, "Mwenzangu, fanya ulichokuja kufanya."

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với ông ta: "Này bạn, [hãy làm] điều bạn đến đây [để làm]."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với ông ta: "Này bạn, bạn đến đây để làm gì thì cứ làm đi."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với ông ta: "Này bạn, hãy làm điều bạn đến đây để làm."

ko.L: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "친구여, 네가 [하러] 온 그 일을 [하여라]."
ko.B: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "친구여, 네가 하러 온 일을 하여라."
ko.R: 예수께서 유다에게 말씀하셨다. "친구여, 네가 하려고 온 일을 어서 하여라."

pt.L: E Jesus lhe disse: "Amigo, [faça] aquilo para que você veio."
pt.B: Jesus lhe disse: "Amigo, faça logo o que veio fazer."
pt.R: Jesus disse a ele: "Amigo, faça o que você veio fazer aqui."

am.L: ኢየሱስም፦ «ወዳጄ፣ የመጣህበትን [አድርግ]።» አለው።
am.B: ኢየሱስም፦ «ወዳጄ፣ የመጣህበትን ቶሎ ፈጽም።» አለው።
am.R: ኢየሱስም፦ «ወዳጄ፣ ልታደርግ የመጣኸውን አድርግ።» አለው።

decisions.choice: for what you are here: a command, "do what you came to do"
alternatives: a question: Friend, why are you here?
an exclamation: what you have come for!
decisions.reason: The Greek is short and unfinished. It is most likely a command, but the older reading as a question is possible.

decisions.choice: friend: companion, said with a note of reproach
decisions.reason: Matthew uses this word only when someone is in the wrong (20:13; 22:12).

decisions.choice: Ami (L); Mon ami (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 20:13, the same word: an address that is polite but cool, said to someone in the wrong (m2); "Mon ami" carries that tone in French. "Camarade" would sound political.

decisions.choice: Mwenzangu
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a companion or comrade, and here it carries a note of reproach (meaning decision m2). "Mwenzangu" (my companion) keeps both; "rafiki" (friend) is warmer than the Greek word.

decisions.choice: "Này bạn" and "bạn" for Jesus' "Friend" to Judas
alternatives: "con", as Jesus speaks to the disciples
decisions.reason: As the king's and the landowner's "Friend" in the Vietnamese Matthew 20:13 and 22:12: a courteous address that carries a note of reproach (meaning decision). Jesus no longer says "con" to the disciple who has come to hand him over.

decisions.choice: "친구여" for hetaire; a command, "... 일을 하여라"
decisions.reason: "친구여" is the word of the Korean Matthew 20:13 and 22:12, where the same address carries a note of reproach. The meaning decision reads the words as a command; the question is in its footnote. L brackets the verbs Korean needs.

decisions.choice: "ወዳጄ" (friend, companion)
decisions.reason: "ወዳጄ" is the usual address to a companion and can carry the note of reproach the scene has (meaning decision m2); "ጓደኛዬ" sounds like a peer of the same age and is too casual.

source.text: τότε προσελθόντες ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Then having come they laid the hands on the Jesus and seized him.

en.L: Then they came and laid hands on Jesus and seized {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: At that, the crowd moved in. They laid hands on Jesus and arrested {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Then the men came and grabbed Jesus. They arrested {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Entonces se acercaron, pusieron las manos sobre Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} sujetaron.
es.B: En ese momento la multitud se adelantó. Pusieron las manos sobre Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} arrestaron.
es.R: Entonces los hombres se acercaron y agarraron a Jesús. Lo arrestaron.

fr.L: Alors, s’étant approchés, ils mirent les mains sur Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} saisirent.
fr.B: Alors la foule s’avança. Ils mirent la main sur Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}arrêtèrent.
fr.R: Alors les hommes sont venus et ils ont attrapé Jésus. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont arrêté.
